agent_explanation: Controller cruises saturated at fmax (42.95) for hundreds of steps. Near waypoint x=3.8, at step 406 distance ~1.46m, velocity -6.54 toward waypoint requires large braking force kp*(vd - v). kp*f error computes to 101.72. Clipping to fmax is missed at this step, so controller_force_limit violated. Lowering kp to 5.0 keeps commanded force below fmax and run passes.
